<USER_REQUEST>
You are Antigreavity, an expert autonomous coding agent. You are working on behalf of team BILIO for the Samsung  Theme 05: Interruptible Real-Time Agents.

Your job is to take an existing open-source repository (TriageLine), fork it, set it up completely, rename it to BILIO, personalize it for maximum hackathon score, and prepare it for final submission. You must work autonomously, make every decision grounded in the scoring rubric, and complete all steps without needing to ask questions — all information you need is provided below.

===============================================================
SCORING RUBRIC (internalize this — every decision you make must optimize against it)
===============================================================
- Task Completion:       40%  — correct tool calls, valid slot extraction, accurate state snapshots
- Interruption Recovery: 35%  — fast cancellation of stale calls, no re-runs, updated snapshots
- Response Latency:      15%  — time to first spoken action after user input
- Safety & Protocol:     10%  — zero duplicate state-changing calls, valid JSON, schema adherence
- Quality multiplier: 0.80x–1.20x on transcript naturalness and relevance
- Hidden multimodal bonus: 1.5x multiplier on audio/visual scenarios

Interruption Recovery (35%) + Task Completion (40%) = 75% of total score. Prioritize these two above everything else.

===============================================================
SOURCE REPOSITORY
===============================================================
URL: https://github.com/RomitDeokar/TriageLine
This is a fully working Samsung Theme 05 agent. It scores 91/100 in offline text replay and 29/30 on held-out scenarios. Your job is to fork it, set it up, rename it BILIO, and improve it.

===============================================================
STEP 1 — FORK AND CLONE
===============================================================
1. Go to https://github.com/RomitDeokar/TriageLine and fork it to the team GitHub account. Name the fork "bilio-sih26182". Make it PRIVATE immediately after forking (Settings → Danger Zone → Change visibility → Private). It will be made public only at submission time.

2. Clone the fork locally:
   git clone https://github.com/<TEAM_GITHUB_USERNAME>/bilio-sih26182.git
   cd bilio-sih26182

3. Add upstream remote:
   git remote add upstream https://github.com/RomitDeokar/TriageLine.git

===============================================================
STEP 2 — SYSTEM PREREQUISITES (verify each before proceeding)
===============================================================
- Python must be 3.10, 3.11, or 3.12. Verify: python3 --version
  If wrong version: install pyenv and run: pyenv install 3.12.0 && pyenv local 3.12.0

- ffmpeg must be on PATH. Verify: ffmpeg -version
  Ubuntu: sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg
  macOS:  brew install ffmpeg

- Node.js 18+ required. Verify: node --version
  Install if missing: https://nodejs.org (LTS version)

- git must be installed. Verify: git --version

===============================================================
STEP 3 — API KEYS (DO NOT PROCEED WITHOUT THESE — get them now)
===============================================================
The team lead (Rishith) must supply these. If not yet available, open each URL and sign up:

LIVEKIT (free):
  Sign up: https://livekit.io/cloud → Create project → Settings → Keys
  Values needed: LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET

DEEPGRAM (free $200 credit, no card needed):
  Sign up: https://console.deepgram.com → API Keys → Create Key
  Value needed: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  NOTE: Use Deepgram as primary STT/TTS provider — lowest latency, best for the 15% latency score.

OPENAI (paid, ~$2 for full run):
  Sign up: https://platform.openai.com → API Keys → Create key. Load $5 minimum.
  Value needed: OPENAI_API_KEY
  NOTE: Used ONLY for the official gpt-4o judge. Required for --require-judge flag.

GEMINI (free):
  Sign up: https://aistudio.google.com → Get API Key
  Value needed: GEMINI_API_KEY
  NOTE: Fallback for STT/TTS if Deepgram fails. Also used in LLM planner chain.

CEREBRAS (free tier):
  Sign up: https://cloud.cerebras.ai
  Value needed: CEREBRAS_API_KEY
  NOTE: Part of LLM failover chain. Optional but recommended.

===============================================================
STEP 4 — ENVIRONMENT SETUP
===============================================================
Run these commands in order from the repo root:

  python3.12 -m venv .venv
  source .venv/bin/activate
  pip install --upgrade pip
  pip install -r requirements-fdb.txt
  pip install -r requirements-app.txt
  pip install pytest
  cd ui && npm ci && cd ..

Verify everything installed correctly:
  python -m pytest tests livekit_agent/adapter_tests -q
  # Expected: 224 passed, 0 failed

  cd ui && npm test && cd ..
  # Expected: 10 passed

  python scripts/heldout_eval.py
  # Expected: 29/30

  python scripts/integrity_audit.py --strict-comments
  # Expected: PASS

If any of these fail, fix the failure before proceeding. Do not skip verification.

===============================================================
STEP 5 — CONFIGURE .env FILES
===============================================================
Create root .env:
  cp .env.example .env

Fill .env with all API keys. The exact content must be:

  LIVEKIT_URL=wss://<your-project>.livekit.cloud
  LIVEKIT_API_KEY=<value>
  LIVEKIT_API_SECRET=<value>
  TRIAGELINE_AGENT_NAME=
  TRIAGELINE_MODE=benchmark
  DEEPGRAM_API_KEY=<value>
  OPENAI_API_KEY=<value>
  GEMINI_API_KEY=<value>
  CEREBRAS_API_KEY=<value>
  TRIAGELINE_ENV=development
  TRIAGELINE_STT_PROVIDER=auto
  TRIAGELINE_TTS_PROVIDER=auto

CRITICAL: TRIAGELINE_AGENT_NAME must be BLANK (empty string) for the FDB-v3 benchmark runner to dispatch correctly. Do not put a name here.

Create the LiveKit worker .env:
  cp .env.example livekit_agent/.env.local
  # Fill livekit_agent/.env.local with the EXACT same values as root .env above.
  # The run script says livekit_agent/.env.local takes priority for the worker.

Security: Verify both files are in .gitignore:
  grep -E "^\.env$|^\.env\.local$|env\.local" .gitignore
  If missing, add them: echo ".env" >> .gitignore && echo "*.env.local" >> .gitignore

===============================================================
STEP 6 — RENAME TriageLine → BILIO THROUGHOUT
===============================================================
Run this bulk rename from the repo root (with .venv active):

  # First do a dry-run to see scope:
  grep -r "TriageLine" --include="*.py" --include="*.yaml" --include="*.md" --include="*.txt" --include="*.sh" -l

  # Then execute the rename:
  find . -type f \( -name "*.py" -o -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.md" -o -name "*.txt" -o -name "*.sh" -o -name "*.json" \) \
    -not -path "./.venv/*" \
    -not -path "./.git/*" \
    -not -path "./node_modules/*" \
    -exec sed -i 's/TriageLine/BILIO/g; s/triageline/bilio/g' {} +

  # Rename result file identifier (important for submission):
  # The provider_name in submission.yaml determines the result filename.
  # Ensure submission.yaml has: provider_name: bilio
  # This means results will be written to result_bilio.json

After renaming, re-run the test suite to catch any regressions:
  python -m pytest tests livekit_agent/adapter_tests -q
  # Fix any tests that broke due to renamed string literals

===============================================================
STEP 7 — FILL submission.yaml COMPLETELY
===============================================================
Open submission.yaml and set every field to real values:

  team_name: BILIO
  sih_problem_id: SIH26182
  theme: "05"
  agent_name: bilio
  provider_name: bilio
  repo_url: https://github.com/<TEAM_GITHUB_USERNAME>/bilio-sih26182
  reported_scores:
    offline_text_replay: <fill after running --offline-text>
    heldout_rules_only: 29   # from scripts/heldout_eval.py
    live_livekit_judged: <fill after full scored run>
  extension_use_case:
    name: "BILIO Triage Line — Roadside Incident Response"
    description: >
      A voice-native incident triage agent handling full-duplex interruptions
      during roadside emergencies. Uses two-phase commit (PROPOSED → CONFIRMED
      → FINALIZED) for all consequential dispatch actions. Supports mid-sentence
      corrections to location and hazard details with zero duplicate dispatches.
  known_limitations:
    - "All tools are simulated in-memory, no real CAD or emergency integration"
    - "Sessions are process-local, single replica"
    - "Location extraction is regex-based with no geocoding"

===============================================================
STEP 8 — PERSONALIZATION CHANGES (ordered by score impact)
===============================================================

--- 8A. INTERRUPTION CLASSIFIER (impacts 35% Interruption Recovery score) ---
FILE: agent/nlu.py
Find the interruption type classifier (REVISE / RETRACT / SWITCH).
Expand trigger phrase lists as follows:

REVISE triggers (user corrects a slot mid-stream):
  Add: "no wait", "actually", "sorry I meant", "change that to", "correction",
       "not X but Y", "scratch that", "let me rephrase", "I meant to say",
       "hold on", "wait no", "make it", "switch it to", "update that to",
       "on second thought", "let me correct that"

RETRACT triggers (user cancels entire request):
  Add: "cancel everything", "forget the whole thing", "never mind all of that",
       "start over", "forget it", "disregard that", "drop it", "abort"

SWITCH triggers (user pivots to different task entirely):
  Add: "different question", "forget it instead", "actually can you",
       "on another note", "new request", "ignore that, instead"

After each change, run:
  python run_local.py --all --agent agent.agent:ParticipantAgent
  Target: 9/9 or at minimum same as before your change.

--- 8B. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT PHRASES (impacts quality multiplier 0.80x–1.20x) ---
FILE: agent/nlu.py
Find the ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS or FILLERS list.
Replace with at least 20 unique, natural phrases:

  "On it!", "Absolutely, give me a second.", "Got you — checking now.",
  "Sure thing, one moment.", "Understood — pulling that up.",
  "Let me grab that for you.", "Right away.", "I'm on it.",
  "Of course, just a moment.", "Sure, looking into that now.",
  "Got it, hold on a sec.", "Let me check that for you.",
  "One moment please.", "Working on it.", "On it right away.",
  "Understood, searching now.", "Allow me a moment.",
  "That's noted — let me look.", "I'll get that sorted.",
  "Pulling that up now."

--- 8C. SLOT TRACKING VERIFICATION (impacts 40% Task Completion score) ---
FILE: agent/agent.py
Read the slot state update logic carefully. Verify these invariants hold:

  INVARIANT 1: A localized correction ("change departure to Monday") updates
  ONLY the departure_date slot. All other slots remain unchanged. Write a test
  that asserts this.

  INVARIANT 2: When an interruption occurs mid-tool-execution, the CANCEL
  action for the in-flight call_id is emitted BEFORE any new planning begins.
  Verify by searching for where cancel actions are emitted and confirming the
  ordering in the coordination layer.

  INVARIANT 3: State snapshots emitted at turn end always contain ALL slots —
  both filled (with values) and unfilled (explicitly null). Never omit a slot
  key entirely.

Write or update tests in tests/ covering all three invariants.

--- 8D. DUPLICATE CALL PREVENTION (impacts 10% Safety & Protocol score) ---
FILE: agent/agent.py (operation ledger section)
Verify these invariants:

  INVARIANT 1: Every state-modifying tool call (booking, ticket creation,
  cancellation) is issued with a unique call_id (UUID). Verify the UUID is
  generated fresh at call time using uuid.uuid4().

  INVARIANT 2: Before issuing any state-modifying call, the operation ledger
  is checked. If a call with the same tool name and identical arguments is
  already in-flight, the new call is SUPPRESSED (not issued). The agent should
  instead emit a spoken filler while waiting for the existing call to resolve.

  INVARIANT 3: Read-only tools (flight_search, get_status) are NOT tracked in
  the operation ledger and can be called multiple times freely.

  Write a test: issue state-modifying call → immediately issue same call again
  → assert only ONE tool_call action was emitted in the trace.

--- 8E. MULTIMODAL GROUNDING (impacts 1.5x bonus multiplier on hidden set) ---
FILE: agent/perception.py
Make these targeted improvements:

  For WAV inputs: Add a pre-check for audio duration and energy level.
  If clip duration < 0.3 seconds or RMS energy < threshold, skip transcription
  and immediately emit a spoken clarification: "I didn't quite catch that —
  could you repeat?" This prevents bad transcription from scoring zero.

  For PNG frame inputs: Add a confidence threshold check on CLIP output.
  If top-1 confidence < 0.55, emit: "I can see something in the image but
  want to make sure I understand correctly — could you describe what you're
  looking at?" A correct clarification scores better than a wrong answer.

  Ensure ALL multimodal processing runs as asyncio tasks in the slow path.
  The fast path must emit an acknowledgement immediately:
    Audio: "Let me listen to that."
    Image: "Let me take a look at that image."
  This ensures the latency metric (15%) is satisfied even for slow modalities.

===============================================================
STEP 9 — EXTENSION USE CASE: BILIO TRIAGE LINE
===============================================================
FILE: livekit_agent/triage_livekit_agent.py
FILE: livekit_agent/triage_brain.py

The Triage Line extension (20% of score) works out of the box. Make these
targeted customizations:

1. Change the agent greeting in triage_livekit_agent.py:
   Find the initial greeting string and change it to:
   "BILIO Emergency Assist — I'm here to help. Are you in a safe location?
   Tell me what's happening."

2. DO NOT touch the two-phase commit logic in triage_brain.py.
   The PROPOSED → PENDING_CONFIRMATION → FINALIZED state machine is a scored
   differentiator. Keep it exactly as-is.

3. Test the extension:
   In terminal 1:
     TRIAGELINE_TRIAGE_AGENT_NAME=bilio-triage python livekit_agent/triage_livekit_agent.py dev
   In terminal 2:
     python -m ui
   Open browser: http://localhost:8080/rtc.html?flow=triage
   Make a test call. Interrupt with a location correction mid-sentence.
   Verify: the stale dispatch is ABORTED and the agent re-deliberates with
   the corrected location before confirming.

===============================================================
STEP 10 — RUN THE BENCHMARK AND RECORD SCORES
===============================================================
Run in this exact order:

1. Offline text replay (no API credits, fast):
   PYTHON=python3.12 ./run_fdb_v3.sh --offline-text
   Record score → put in submission.yaml: reported_scores.offline_text_replay

2. Smoke run (5 scenarios, uses API credits):
   PYTHON=python3.12 ./run_fdb_v3.sh --limit 5 --require-judge
   If this passes with all 5 showing status "completed", proceed.
   If any fail, read results/<latest>/*.log and fix the issue.

3. Full scored run (all 9 scenarios):
   PYTHON=python3.12 ./run_fdb_v3.sh --require-judge
   Record score → put in submission.yaml: reported_scores.live_livekit_judged
   Commit the results/ folder to git.

4. After a successful run:
   cat results/results.md
   Check per-turn latency. If response median > 1.5s, set in .env:
     TRIAGELINE_SETTLE_S=0.3
   And re-run.

===============================================================
STEP 11 — FINAL COMMIT AND SUBMISSION
===============================================================
After all runs complete and scores are recorded:

  # Run full test suite one final time:
  python -m pytest tests livekit_agent/adapter_tests -q
  python scripts/heldout_eval.py
  python scripts/integrity_audit.py --strict-comments
  cd ui && npm test && cd ..

  # Commit everything:
  git add .
  git commit -m "BILIO: final submission — live score XX/100, offline 91/100, heldout 29/30"
  git push origin main

  # Make repo public for submission:
  # GitHub → Settings → Danger Zone → Change visibility → Public

  # Submit your repo URL: https://github.com/<TEAM_GITHUB_USERNAME>/bilio-sih26182

===============================================================
CRITICAL DO-NOT-DO LIST (violations cost points or cause disqualification)
===============================================================
- DO NOT set TRIAGELINE_AGENT_NAME in .env during the benchmark run. Leave blank.
- DO NOT issue a state-modifying tool call twice with the same arguments. Zero tolerance.
- DO NOT remove or bypass the integrity audit. It must PASS on final commit.
- DO NOT memorize benchmark scenario IDs or expected outputs in your code. Rules must be schema-driven only.
- DO NOT modify run_fdb_v3.sh. The evaluation script is used by organizers as-is.
- DO NOT add cross-session state persistence. Scope is session-only per Theme 05 guide §6.
- DO NOT spend time on: wake-word detection, voice synthesis tuning, UI redesign, new unscored features.
- DO NOT commit .env or livekit_agent/.env.local to git. Keys must stay local.

===============================================================
KEY FILES REFERENCE
===============================================================
agent/agent.py              → Core orchestration, fast/slow path, slot state, snapshots
agent/nlu.py                → Fast-path NLU, interruption classifier, acknowledgements
agent/perception.py         → Multimodal: ASR on WAV, CLIP on PNG frames
livekit_agent/cascaded_agent.py → LiveKit worker wrapping the core agent
livekit_agent/triage_livekit_agent.py → Extension use case worker
livekit_agent/triage_brain.py → Two-phase commit for triage actions
scenarios/                  → 9 public test scenarios (read these carefully)
scenarios_heldout/          → 30 held-out paraphrase scenarios (validation only)
scripts/heldout_eval.py     → Run held-out eval: target 29/30
scripts/integrity_audit.py  → Run integrity check: must PASS
run_fdb_v3.sh               → THE scored evaluation runner — do not modify
run_local.py                → Fast local development feedback loop
submission.yaml             → Fill completely before submitting

===============================================================
SUCCESS CRITERIA
===============================================================
You are done when ALL of the following are true:
  [ ] python -m pytest tests livekit_agent/adapter_tests -q → 0 failures
  [ ] python scripts/heldout_eval.py → 29/30 or better
  [ ] python scripts/integrity_audit.py --strict-comments → PASS
  [ ] PYTHON=python3.12 ./run_fdb_v3.sh --limit 5 --require-judge → all 5 completed
  [ ] PYTHON=python3.12 ./run_fdb_v3.sh --require-judge → score recorded in submission.yaml
  [ ] submission.yaml has real values in every field including live_livekit_judged
  [ ] No .env files committed to git
  [ ] All "TriageLine" references replaced with "BILIO" in non-test code
  [ ] Triage Line extension tested end-to-end with live interruption
  [ ] Final commit pushed, repo made public, submission URL ready

Team: BILIO | Problem: SIH26182 | Theme: 05 | Lead: Rishith
===============================================================


github.com/RomitDeokar/TriageLine 
</USER_REQUEST>
